_readme: Canonical Arabic spellings of transliterated names (owner order 2026-08-11,
after «الهدالين» reached the Arabic edition for الهذالين). RULE, binding on
every agent and desk: before an Arabic edition uses a personal name that
arrived through English or Hebrew, VERIFY the spelling against Arabic-language
sources covering the same story (الجزيرة نت، وفا، معا، عرب 48، العربي الجديد،
CNN بالعربية…) and record the verified form here with its source. build.py
loads this file and flags any listed wrong variant in briefs and originals
exactly like machine diction. Fail-open: a broken lexicon disables the net,
Entry fields: latin (as the wires spell it), ar (verified Arabic form),
wrong (DISTINCTIVE strings matched as substrings — never list a string that
is also an ordinary Arabic word on its own), verified (source + date).
Grow this file with every name the desks verify; never delete an entry —
supersede it by editing in place.
